stated: Manage public finances responsibly to get national debt falling as a share of the economy and ensure day-to-day spending does not exceed taxes, while making necessary investments.

source.quote: Fostering stability, certainty and confidence by managing the public finances responsibly to get the national debt falling as a share of the economy and ensure that day-to-day spending does not exceed the amount raised in taxes, while making the investments our country needs.

bearing_set.reason: The policy directly targets debt-to-GDP trajectory and current-budget balance — textbook O12 indicators of debt-path sustainability and whether spending is funded or borrowed.

A binding fiscal consolidation rule affects borrowing costs, macroeconomic credibility, and public investment capacity (dual-horizon: near-term demand squeeze vs. long-run lower debt-interest burden), materially moving O13's real-living-standards and productivity indicators.

membership_note: O12 is the primary home; O13 earns a genuine dual-horizon bearing because fiscal rules shape the investment environment and aggregate living standards trajectory. Services effects (O3/O7/O8) are too implementation-dependent to pin to a specific indicator without knowing where cuts fall; O11 is unaffected as the rule does not specify tax changes.
